vata.howTo: Around sunrise, at the same time every day
vata.reason: Before sunrise is vata time, when the mind is clearest and most alert. Sleeping past about 6 runs into kapha time, which brings heaviness and dullness.

pitta.reason: Before sunrise is vata time, when the mind is clearest and most alert. Sleeping past about 6 runs into kapha time, which brings heaviness and dullness.

kapha.reason: Before sunrise is vata time, when the mind is clearest and most alert. Sleeping past about 6 runs into kapha time, which brings heaviness and dullness.

vata.howTo: Back to front, 5 to 7 strokes, then brush your teeth
vata.reason: Your body clears waste while you sleep, and some of it collects on your tongue. Brushing doesn't remove it. Scraping also cuts down on odor-causing bacteria.

pitta.howTo: Back to front, 5 to 7 strokes, then brush your teeth

vata.howTo: A cup of warm water before anything else
vata.reason: Warm water first thing helps your body finish the cleansing it does overnight, and it gets your bowels moving.

pitta.howTo: A cup of warm water before anything else
pitta.reason: Warm water first thing helps your body finish the cleansing it does overnight, and it gets your bowels moving.

vata.howTo: Sesame oil, 10 to 20 minutes, then shower
vata.reason: It improves circulation, softens and nourishes the skin, and helps clear out impurities. Sesame suits cooler types.

pitta.howTo: Coconut or sunflower oil, 10 to 20 minutes, then shower
pitta.reason: It improves circulation, softens and nourishes the skin, and helps clear out impurities. Coconut and sunflower suit warmer types.

kapha.howTo: Sesame oil, 10 to 20 minutes, then shower
kapha.reason: It improves circulation, softens and nourishes the skin, and helps clear out impurities. Sesame suits cooler types.

vata.howTo: Walking or yoga. Morning, ideally between 6 and 10
vata.reason: 6 to 10 a.m. is kapha time, when your body is strongest. Moving then clears the sluggishness that builds up overnight.

pitta.howTo: Walking or yoga. Morning, ideally between 6 and 10
pitta.reason: 6 to 10 a.m. is kapha time, when your body is strongest. Moving then clears the sluggishness that builds up overnight.

kapha.howTo: Vigorous: brisk exercise or Sun Salutations. Morning, ideally between 6 and 10
kapha.reason: 6 to 10 a.m. is kapha time, when your body is strongest. Moving then clears the sluggishness that builds up overnight.

vata.howTo: A few minutes of slow breathing, then a few minutes of quiet sitting
vata.reason: A few quiet minutes reset your mind before the day starts. The hour before sunrise is especially good for this.

pitta.howTo: A few minutes of slow breathing, then a few minutes of quiet sitting

vata.howTo: Make lunch the biggest meal of the day
vata.reason: Digestion is strongest in pitta time, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Eating heavy later is harder on digestion, so keep supper light.

pitta.howTo: Make lunch the biggest meal of the day
pitta.reason: Digestion is strongest in pitta time, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Eating heavy later is harder on digestion, so keep supper light.

vata.howTo: Lights out around 10, no later than 11
vata.reason: From 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. your body digests and repairs. Staying up through it can bring a second wind that keeps you awake.
